item.title: Terraform to OpenTofu: is it worth migrating?
item.description: A reader sent me a question I’ve been getting more often lately: they’re running Terraform 1.5, S3 backend, no Terraform Cloud, no HCP. Is it worth moving to OpenTofu? Short answer: probably yes, and this setup happens to be close to the easiest case there is. Here’s why.
